corner-cover:
testcase = int(input())
answers = []
for i in range(testcase):
    dimension_rectangle = input().split()
    numbers = []
    for j in range(len(dimension_rectangle)):
        num = int(dimension_rectangle[j])
        numbers.append(num)
    n = numbers[0]
    m = numbers[1]
    A = numbers[2]
    B = numbers[3]
    landscape = ((n >= A and m >= B) and (A == n or B == m))
    portrait = ((n >= B and m >= A) and (B == n or A == m))
    if landscape or portrait:
        answers.append("YES")
    else:
        answers.append("NO")
for answer in answers:
    print(answer)
